title: opo::ruleset
description: One regional rule set: the values an object's declared rule set takes under a regulation (spec §4.4, decision 0020). Lives on its own node, usually in a layer.

id.description: The rule-set id declared in the object's opo::rules.rulesets (e.g. accessibility).

source.description: The regulation and clauses the values come from.

values.description: Field name to FEEL expression or literal.
